purpose: Material that WAS in this repository and was taken out. It must not come back. This list grows with every owner decision.

Pinned to those two tags on purpose - they are the moments the withdrawal happened between, and unlike a branch they do not move. Two readings were tried first and both were wrong: `git diff --diff-filter=D` counts a case-rename as a withdrawal, and comparing against the working tree counts later ordinary work as one. Each produced a phantom entry for a file that is lawfully here.
scope_note: Exact paths on purpose. A pattern such as `samples/*` would also forbid the synthetic samples that belong here.
history_note: History is deliberately not rewritten (decision 20), so these paths still exist in old commits and tags. What must stay clean is the present: working tree and branch tips.
